name: Berrocalejo (Spain)
description: White field with a green stripe near the top and a blue stripe near the bottom.
history: The arms and the flag of Berrocalejo were approved by the Order of 2 November 1993 published in the Diario Oficial de Extremadura on 13 November 1993, approved by the Consejero de Presidencia y Trabajo Joaquín Cuello after the municipal council's approval on 30 November 1992.
